name: WordAI
author: softcoy

sections.description:
WordAI Auto Content Writer is an AI-powered writing solution with multi-provider support. Use OpenAI or Google Gemini for fast, natural content generation and image creation. It is designed for SEO writing and better search visibility. You will need an API key for your chosen provider.

WordAI – AI Driven Content Writing Features

  • Multi-provider AI: OpenAI + Google Gemini
  • Auto Title, Content, Excerpt, and Tags generation
  • AI Image generation with size and style controls
  • Suggest Titles for Posts/Pages/Products with one-click insert
  • Supports all major languages
  • Writing Styles + Writing Tones
  • WooCommerce product title/description/short description generation
  • WooCommerce product image generation
  • Latest OpenAI and Gemini models supported
  • Smooth generation flow designed for better SEO writing outcomes

Pro SEO Features (WordAI Pro)

Unlock SEO Optimization for your content:
* SEO Title, Meta Description, and Focus Keyword generation
* Robots Meta and Canonical URL controls
* Schema Type (JSON-LD) selection
* Social Meta (Open Graph + Twitter) controls
* Google SERP preview and scoring
sections.installation:
1. Install ‘WordAI’ Auto Content Writer by uploading the plugin to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory inside.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WordAI -> API Settings and choose your AI Provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini).
  4. Add your API key, save settings, then start generating content and images.
sections.faq:
What is WordAI?

WordAI is an AI content generation plugin that helps you write blog posts, pages, product descriptions, and more in seconds. It supports OpenAI and Google Gemini so you can choose the provider that fits your workflow.

Do I need an API key?

Yes. You must add an API key for your chosen provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini) in WordAI -> API Settings.

Which AI models are supported?

WordAI supports the latest OpenAI and Google Gemini models available in your account. Choose your preferred model in API Settings.

Does WordAI support multiple languages?

Yes. Choose your language in Content Settings and generate content in that language.

Is the content unique and human-like?

Yes. WordAI generates natural, original content based on your prompts and settings (tone, style, length, etc.).

Are the titles SEO friendly?

Yes. WordAI can generate SEO-friendly titles and suggest multiple title variations to improve click-through rate.

Can I control title length, paragraphs, tags, and excerpts?

Yes. You can set title length, number of paragraphs, tag count, and excerpt length in Content Settings.

Are tags and excerpts SEO optimized?

Yes. Tags and excerpts are generated to be relevant and concise for SEO writing. Pro includes advanced SEO metadata tools.

Can I generate images?

Yes. WordAI supports AI image generation with size and style options. You can also choose how many images to generate.

Can I use WordAI for WooCommerce?

Yes. WordAI supports product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and product image generation.

What is included in WordAI Pro?

WordAI Pro unlocks the full SEO Optimization suite (SEO Title, Meta Description, Focus Keyword, Robots Meta, Canonical URL, Schema Type, Social Meta, and SERP preview).

Why are my results truncated?

This usually happens when API parameters are too strict. Reset to defaults in API Settings, then try again.

I do not see output. What should I check?

If your server blocks streaming, turn off Streaming in API Settings and test again.
